## Definitions

$\pi_0:$ the overall proportion of null genes; 1 means all genes are null
$p:$ the vector of gene-specific probabilities of null status; 1 means that particular gene is certainly null
$D:$ the vector of discrete gene-specific null status (for a simulation); 1 means that particular gene is null (actually, since this is simulated)

## Calculations

$$
p(D = 1 | y, \theta) = \frac{ p(y | D = 1, \theta) p(D | \theta)}{\sum_{d = 0}^1 p(y | D = d, \theta) P(D = d | \theta)}
$$ 
Since I am storing $log(p(y | D = d, \theta) p(D = d | \theta))$ in `ll[i, 2 - d]`,
this is `exp(ll[i, 1]) / sum(exp(ll[i, 1]) + exp(ll[i, 2]))`
